F017.summary: Projects oRPC router has full CRUD with Zod validation, user isolation, and proper error codes

All CRUD procedures implemented.detail: list, get, create, update, delete procedures. All use protectedProcedure (requires auth). Create checks duplicate path. Update validates at least one field.

Input validated with Zod.detail: createProjectInput validates name, path (absolute), status, settings. updateProjectInput validates partial fields with refine for non-empty. All use Zod schemas from @nomos-ai/types.

Type-safe client generated.detail: appRouter exports AppRouter type and AppRouterClient type from router index. oRPC client in web uses createORPCClient with RPCLink for fully typed client.

Errors return proper codes.detail: Uses ORPCError with NOT_FOUND, FORBIDDEN, CONFLICT codes. handleRepositoryError for DB errors.

F018.summary: Features oRPC router has comprehensive procedures including status transitions, bulk operations, and dependency resolution

All feature procedures work.detail: list (with status/phase filters), get, create, update, delete, updateStatus, bulkCreate, getDependencyOrder procedures implemented.

Status transitions validated.detail: updateStatus checks FEATURE_VALID_TRANSITIONS before allowing status change. Throws BAD_REQUEST with descriptive message on invalid transition.

Bulk operations efficient.detail: bulkCreate and bulk status update (via featureRepository.bulkUpdateStatusWithValidation) use transactions for atomicity.

Dependency resolution.detail: getDependencyOrder procedure resolves dependency graph using dedicated dependency-resolver lib. Returns ordered features with blocking info.

F019.summary: Sessions oRPC router has CRUD plus agent session creation, status transitions, and output append

Create procedure works.detail: Basic create and createAgentSession (full Claude SDK session creation). Input validated with Zod including model, tools, maxTurns, cwd, permissionMode.

Get and list procedures.detail: list (filterable by status/featureId), get by ID. Returns from sessionRepository.

Update status procedures.detail: updateStatus validates SESSION_VALID_TRANSITIONS before allowing change. appendOutput procedure for incremental output.

Agent session tracking.detail: createAgentSession integrates with agent-service for full SDK session lifecycle.

F020.summary: React app with TanStack Router properly configured with file-based routing, route tree generation, and multiple pages

React 19 + Vite configured.detail: apps/web/package.json has react@19.2.3, vite@6.2.2. main.tsx uses ReactDOM.createRoot.

TanStack Router working.detail: createRouter with routeTree from generated file (routeTree.gen). Default preload 'intent'. Router context includes orpc and queryClient. Used in 21+ route/component files.

Routes configured.detail: 14 route files: __root, index, dashboard, kanban, agent, terminal, settings, activity, spec, login, projects.index, projects.$projectId, features.$featureId, features.import.

Project/feature pages.detail: Dynamic routes: projects.$projectId.tsx, features.$featureId.tsx for detail pages. kanban.tsx for board view.

F021.summary: Tailwind CSS 4 with shadcn/ui components, dark mode support via theme provider, and theme registry

Tailwind classes working.detail: tailwindcss@4.0.15 + @tailwindcss/vite in deps. vite.config.ts imports @tailwindcss/vite plugin.

shadcn/ui components available.detail: 13 shadcn/ui components in apps/web/src/components/ui/: button, card, checkbox, dialog, dropdown-menu, input, label, select, sheet, skeleton, textarea, badge, sonner.

Dark mode toggle works.detail: next-themes@0.4.6 in dependencies. Theme provider component exists. Theme registry with multiple themes. General settings tab likely has toggle.

Theme tokens defined.detail: Theme registry at apps/web/src/lib/themes/ with index.ts and theme-registry.ts for structured theme management.

F022.summary: Zustand store with 4 slices, typed actions, devtools integration, and proper state management

Store created with slices.detail: Main store composes 4 slices: projects, features, sessions, ui. Additional standalone stores: agent-store, terminal-store, auto-mode-store, settings-store.

Actions type-safe.detail: Each slice defines an interface (e.g., ProjectsSlice) with typed actions. Uses StateCreator generic with AppStore intersection type.

Selectors optimized.detail: Actions use set() with named actions for devtools. Slice pattern ensures state immutability.

DevTools integration.detail: Store wrapped in devtools middleware with name 'NomosStore'. Actions have descriptive labels (e.g., 'projects/setProjects').

F023.summary: TanStack Query configured with oRPC client, proper caching, error handling, and mutation invalidation

Query client configured.detail: QueryClient with staleTime: 60s, gcTime: 5min, retry: 3 with exponential backoff. QueryCache with global error handler showing toast.

oRPC hooks generated.detail: createTanstackQueryUtils(client) generates typed query/mutation hooks from oRPC client. Used across 29+ components/routes.

Caching works correctly.detail: Configured with staleTime (1 min), gcTime (5 min), and retry policies. QueryClientProvider wraps app in main.tsx.

Invalidation on mutations.detail: QueryCache error handler supports query invalidation via action button. Mutation retry set to 1. Used throughout components.
